ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New accounts, Sample or trial and later stages need Sample status and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_accounts", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "First contact", 2, "Needs confirmed", 3, "Sample or trial", 4, "Quote issued", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Sample_status__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Sample status and Next step date before moving to Sample or trial.
